failed_attempt.exception: ValueError: sparse matrix exceeds max_nnz; use matrix-free action

resolution: Use an exact symmetric/antisymmetric impurity rotation and solve both dot-exchange parity blocks. Keep both interacting impurity orbitals and all bath QPs; retain the same memory/nonzero limits.
validation: Bounded tests compare energies and physical pairing/spin observables with and without this symmetry reduction, both at finite QP cutoff and in the full finite space.
